# vizarr

The built vizarr viewer this plugin imports, kept as built so its dependencies are not installed.

- Source: `dist/*.js` of [davelopez/vizarr](https://github.com/davelopez/vizarr) at
  `8a4dccb6f1f01a3a50e0f9d6fee1047349815e32` (branch `galaxy_adapter`), which adds the build to
  [hms-dbmi/vizarr](https://github.com/hms-dbmi/vizarr) `ede32328e7d5ed01c2ad8add352d5db6ea239043`.
- Copied unchanged except for each file's trailing `sourceMappingURL` comment; the maps are left out.
